modes.name: classic
modes.purpose: Rounds, a buy menu, bomb and hostages. The game as it shipped.

modes.name: team-dm
modes.purpose: Respawn where you fell, teams still matter, buy what you like.

modes.name: ffa-dm
modes.purpose: Respawn, everybody is a target, low gravity — no teams.

modes.name: gungame
modes.purpose: A weapon ladder: every kill is the next gun, knife to win.

modes.name: scoutz
modes.purpose: Low gravity, high air control, scouts and knives.

modes.name: match
modes.purpose: League rules: 1:45 rounds, $800 to start, friendly fire on, no balancing. The rules only — somebody still runs the match.

modes.name: aim
modes.purpose: One room, two rifles. The server hands out an AK or an M4 and a Deagle; no buying, no economy.

modes.name: awp
modes.purpose: One rifle, one shot. Long sightlines and a scope.

modes.name: climb
modes.purpose: No opponents: a map, a clock and a jump. High air control, no speed cap on landing.

modes.name: 35hp
modes.purpose: Thirty-five health and a Deagle each. Two shots decide it.

modes.name: hns
modes.purpose: The terrorists hide with a knife, the counter-terrorists come looking. Fifteen seconds to disappear.

modes.name: jail
modes.purpose: Guards with guns, prisoners with knives, and one guard giving orders. The rules are a person, not a plugin.

modes.name: infect
modes.purpose: One side armed, the other knives; everyone who dies changes sides. The idea under every zombie mod.

modes.name: scavenge
modes.purpose: A knife and nothing else. No buy menu — every gun in the round is one the map left on the floor.
